influences.name: James Holden
influences.context: The person who got me into these is James Holden; his release, The Inheritors, is my favorite album from last year. He's a dance producer who is now making more experimental music. He's one of those guys who programs everything in Max/MSP.

influences.name: Beverly Glenn Copeland
influences.context: My favorite example is an album that I've completely fallen in love with over the years I was making Suddenly. It's by Beverly Glenn Copeland and it's called Keyboard Fantasies... The way the music absorbs that and then projects outward is in this beautiful, open, empathetic, inclusive, and encompassing way.

influences.name: Debussy
influences.context: For example, there's a track called "Sonny's Time" where I'm playing this Debussy style piano motif and it's bent and warped in this way
